title: Linear coordinate comparison of frames after arbitrary base change
statement: Let f:T→S be a map of Noetherian schemes and F a rank-r locally free module on S. Let eS and eT be frames for F on V⊆S and tensorPullback(f)(F) on U⊆T. For an arbitrary scheme W and maps j:W→T, a:W→U and g:W→V with a U.ι=j and j f=g V.ι, there exists H∈GL_r(Γ(W,O_W)) such that the target inverse chart pulled along a and followed by the canonical bundle baseChange map equals affineTraceLinearMap(H) followed by the source inverse chart pulled along g. This is solely an equality of scheme maps.

proof.text: Use the canonical isomorphism between the usual module pullback and tensorPullback, supplied by uniqueness of left adjoints. Pull eS along g and eT along a, using restriction-to-pullback, pullback composition and pullbackFreeIso. The base-map equality identifies their sources and gives a concrete free-module isomorphism phi on W. Its adjunction image is exactly the unit used to define baseChange.

Let C and D be the freeMatrix matrices of phi and its inverse, reindexed from ULift(Fin r) to Fin r. Evaluate composition on global free sections to show that freeMatrix reverses categorical composition. Apply this to the inverse identities to get CD=DC=1. Thus H with value C transpose and inverse D transpose belongs to GL_r(Gamma(W,O_W)). This constructs H without any existence theorem or affine hypothesis.

The structural equations give a lift k of the left-hand composite into the restriction of the source bundle over V. Apply the rectangular generator-coordinate lemma to the canonical module pullback isomorphism. Its coordinate equations agree with those of affineTraceLinearMap(H), since H is the transpose of C and affineTraceMap preserves the ordered coordinates. AffineSpace.hom_ext gives equality after the forward chart; cancel the forward-chart isomorphism and compose with the open inclusion to obtain the claimed inverse-chart equality.

theorem vectorIntegration_baseChange_coordinates
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian T]
    (f : T ⟶ S) (r : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r]
    (V : S.Opens) (eS : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S r F V)
    (U : T.Opens)
    (eT : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization T r
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).obj F) U)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ T) (a : W ⟶ U.toScheme) (g : W ⟶ V.toScheme)
    (ha : a ≫ U.ι = j) (hg : j ≫ f = g ≫ V.ι) :
    ∃ H : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin r) Γ(W, ⊤),
      (affineTraceMap a r ≫ vectorIntegrationChart T r
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).obj F) U eT) ≫
          VectorTraceGeometry.baseChange f r F =
        affineTraceLinearMap W r H ≫
          (affineTraceMap g r ≫ vectorIntegrationChart S r F V eS)
